decision: one bounded regularization control after the initial fixed-c conditional failure
baseline_recipe: fixed c=1, 20k clean-row prefix, seed9011, spline128x128, dropout.05, 2k/10k endpoints
diagnostic: same-state/same-data stateless normalization by dropout two-by-two comparison, 32 dropout streams; no checkpoint state changed
interpretation: Dropout substantially perturbs the training objective. This does not prove it causes the broad posterior, a variance floor, or a capacity limit.
intervention: replay the frozen .05 construction and build under seed9011; set existing Dropout rates to zero before the first optimizer update
initialization_evidence: Record state before/after rate toggle and require equal arrays. Replay the baseline initial deterministic probe; the original full initial state was not persisted, so do not claim a direct comparison against an unavailable initial archive.
comparison: same conditional reference panel and fresh development population/seeds as baseline, all declared endpoints retained
acceptance: existing MC-aware conditional criteria plus calibration; falling loss alone cannot pass
stop: Record pass/fail/inconclusive before any additional capacity, geometry, inferred-c or Bergomi production change.
